title: Notion 向量搜尋的兩年——pod、Turbopuffer、Ray Serve
summary: Notion 兩年內把向量搜尋從專屬 pod 改成 Turbopuffer + Ray Serve，總成本砍九成、p50 query latency 改善 50ms。
widget_questions: At each of the four migration stages (2023.11 pod → 2024.05 serverless → 2025.01 Turbopuffer → 2025.07 xxHash+Ray), what was the architecture snapshot and which billing boundary did this stage remove?
Did relative cost and p50 latency move together across the four migrations, or was cost reduction paid for with latency regression?
Why is xxHash64 the right hash for span change-detection at Notion's 1e9-span scale, and what trade-offs make SHA-256, xxHash32, MD5, CRC32, and BLAKE3 wrong for this specific workload?
In the final 2025.07 architecture, which component owns each responsibility, and what is each component explicitly NOT supposed to know about the others?
How does the Pod-to-Turbopuffer before/after architecture remove the application-side generation routing layer entirely?
